text:
ella_cs: Hey CS squad—Client 'AcroLabs' is onboarding and hitting a burst of 429s right after deploy. They're using Node Lambda + our SDK (v0.8.3). Pattern: many cold starts spawn and each instance calls initialize()/fetch ephemeral token, then fanout requests. 429s last ~15-30s. Any quick remediation?

raj_engineer: Ask for request ids and headers; sounds like ephemeral token stampede or preflight fanout. SDK v0.8.3 had a concurrent-init backoff issue.

ella_cs: Customer sent sanitized logs: 
```
2024-07-02T12:08:01Z req=aa1 POST /v1/chat 200
2024-07-02T12:08:02Z req=aa2 POST /v1/chat 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0
2024-07-02T12:08:02Z req=aa3 POST /v1/chat 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0
```

sam_platform: Classic warmup stampede. Which auth flow? Ephemeral JWTs via their auth service?

ella_cs: Yes, per-instance short-lived JWTs from their internal auth service.

raj_engineer: Short checklist to send them: (1) Upgrade to Node SDK v0.9+ (fixes concurrent-init backoff). (2) Enable ephemeralTokenCache in SDK so each container reuses a token for its lifetime. (3) During warmup set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 (serializes preflight). (4) Add small randomized init jitter (0-300ms) before initialize(). Example snippet: 
```
const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random() * 300);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, jitter));
await Redwood.initialize({ ephemeralTokenCache: true });
```

maria_ops: Also recommend a single-flight fetch or warming a helper process per host and proxying to it if they control warmup tooling. And document this in onboarding playbook.

ella_cs: Customer applied PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 + jitter and reported ~90% drop in 429s within minutes. They asked if we can make server-side short-term tolerance during new-customer ramps.

sam_platform: We could add a limited grace window for ephemeral token creation during sign-up/onboarding, but that's a product change. For now client-side mitigations are fastest. I'll file a ticket to track an internal follow-up.

infra-bot: Deploy bot created ticket CS-9218 to track SDK upgrade nudges and potential short-term server-side grace.

ella_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the blurb to AcroLabs and close this CS thread unless they re-open.
